extracted.intended_audience: Office of Planning, Programming and Budgeting; Plans Directorate managers and CIA reporting staff responsible for OMB A-44 reporting
extracted.subtask_description: Create and evaluate a consolidated inventory of periodic and recurring reports for the Plans Directorate under OMB Circular A-44, including costing, scope/exclusions, and planned changes to reduce paperwork burden.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consolidated inventory using Form 142
rubrics_metrics.description: This memorandum with Form 142 attachments represents a consolidated inventory of Plans Directorate periodic and recurring reporting as required under OMB Circular A-44.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare a single consolidated inventory (using Form 142 attachments) that lists periodic and recurring reports required under OMB Circular A-44.

rubrics_metrics.name: Handling inconsistent or missing report listings
rubrics_metrics.description: The speed with which the inventory was conducted, the imprecision of reports titles, and the participation of the fifteen components and subordinate units of the Directorate have caused the employment of considerable arbitrariness in sorting out inconsistencies and assigning cost factors. Inter-polations based on submitted data were made in instances where a component should have but did not include a specific report in its listing. In other cases, reports of similar format serving identical purposes but labeled differently have been combined as a single entry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When inventory inputs are inconsistent or incomplete, interpolate missing items where appropriate and combine reports of similar format/identical purpose even if labeled differently; document arbitrariness and assumptions used in reconciling lists.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost computation methodology
rubrics_metrics.description: By and large computations are based on a weighted average grade cost and include only the costs of preparing and issuing the report. Costs of report formulations and echelon use of same were excluded under the Directorate formula. This probably has led to conservative cost factoring.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compute costs using a weighted average grade cost; include only preparation and issuance costs; exclude costs of report formulation and downstream/echelon use to avoid overstating preparation burden (note this produces conservative cost estimates).

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope and exclusions for the inventory
rubrics_metrics.description: In addition to reporting exclusions contained in the several directives, the DDP issued supplementary guidelines excepting all reports required by other CIA directorates and ad hoc items. Included in this submission are administrative management and operational reporting required external of the Agency, reporting required by the Executive Offices and Officers of CIA, reporting levied by DDP components upon other directorates, and administrative, management and operational reporting required within Plans itself.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Define inventory scope clearly: apply directive-based exclusions and DDP supplementary guidelines (exclude reports required by other CIA directorates and ad hoc items); include administrative, management, and operational reports required externally, by Executive Offices/Officers, those levied by DDP components on other directorates, and internal Plans reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include contractual/externally produced report entries
rubrics_metrics.description: entry under Equipment Evaluation Reports representing contractural production outside the Agency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Account for report items that represent contractual production outside the Agency (e.g., equipment evaluation reports) as part of the inventory where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consider programmatic/management changes when projecting reporting goals
rubrics_metrics.description: Major changes in Project Actions, Project Reviews and the Operating Program intended to implement country based programming and to integrate the present fragmented system impact heavily on projected reporting goals to be attained by October 1971. The Directorate believes these changes will in 25X1 Substantial savings ... are estimated to accrue from newly announced DDP changes in Project Actions and Project Review procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When projecting future reporting burden and savings, account for planned management and programmatic reforms (changes in procedures, report modification, frequency changes, discontinuances). Recognize projections may be tentative if no prior experience exists to validate them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use report modification/frequency reduction/discontinuance to realize savings
rubrics_metrics.description: Chief, FE has taken a hard look at specialized reporting generated in response to requirements within his component with the result that he expects through changes in procedures, modification of reports, changes in reporting frequency and discontinuance of others that his Division will realize man-hour savings ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Target specialized reports for procedural change, modification, frequency reduction, or discontinuance as primary mechanisms to realize man-hour and cost savings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not over-attribute savings to OMB Circular A-44
rubrics_metrics.description: For the A-44 exercise the combined Directorate net projected savings is ... about 10 percent of cited current costs. To emphasize again, it is the newly launched management procedures within the Directorate that account for the lion's share of our optimism and of course will not recur at such a level in future years. None of the anticipated savings can be directly attributable to OMB's initiative. It is a happenstance that the Circular A-44 action coincided with major management changes and reporting reviews set off by threats of hijackings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When reporting projected savings, clearly attribute the sources of savings; distinguish between reductions due to internal management changes and those due to external initiatives (do not claim A-44 as the direct cause where it is coincidental).

rubrics_metrics.name: Periodic review to identify low-utility or inappropriate-frequency reports
rubrics_metrics.description: Finally, components identified 14 reports (contained in the inventory) which the preparing unit finds of doubtful utility or questions the frequency level. These will be reviewed during the coming year to determine what if any modification can be effected. Five of these are in response to requirements of other Government Offices. For this reason changes in these areas are considered unlikely.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain a process to identify reports of doubtful utility or questionable frequency and review them for possible modification or discontinuance, while recognizing that reports mandated by other government offices may be resistant to change.

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimize reporting burden on field installations
rubrics_metrics.description: Also, the Directorate has periodically reviewed its generation of paper and the particular burden placed upon field installations in an effort to require only that which is necessary. Experience in this regard tells us there is scant slack in this area.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Continuously assess and minimize the burden placed on field installations by requiring only necessary reporting; be aware that opportunities for further reductions may be limited.
